purpose: Test whether the exact GF(2) rank<=3 clause-block SAT pencil can be decided by replacing scalar Boolean completion with noncommutative matrix blow-ups / noncommutative rank.

unsat_proof: (x1 OR x2) and (x1 OR NOT x2) force x1=1.
Then (NOT x1 OR x3) forces x3=1.
Then (NOT x3 OR x4) and (NOT x3 OR NOT x4) force x4=1 and x4=0 simultaneously.

scalar_pencil.construction: Use the v1.4 GF(2) 2-clause blocks and homogenize as B(y0,x)=diag(y0, y0*M0 + sum_i x_i A_i).
scalar_pencil.boolean_fact: For y0=1 and scalar x_i in GF(2), full rank is equivalent to satisfying the formula, hence no scalar Boolean completion is nonsingular.

two_by_two_blowup_witness.claim: The matrix sum B0 tensor Y0 + B1 tensor X1 + ... + B4 tensor X4 has full rank 22 over GF(2), although the Boolean instance is UNSAT.
two_by_two_blowup_witness.meaning: The noncommutative/blow-up relaxation is strictly looser than Boolean completion already inside the minimal rank<=3 2/3-clause frontier.

source_alignment.source: Atserias, Kolaitis, Severini, Generalized satisfiability problems via operator assignments, JCSS 105 (2019)
source_alignment.relevance: Boolean constraint languages outside the bijunctive/Horn/dual-Horn/valid tractable families can exhibit finite-dimensional operator-assignment satisfiability gaps; 3SAT lies in the gap regime.

source_alignment.source: Ivanyos, Qiao and related noncommutative-rank literature
source_alignment.relevance: Noncommutative rank is polynomially computable but is a relaxation of commutative/scalar rank; v1.5 shows that this relaxation is unsound for the frozen Boolean SAT pencil.

algorithmic_consequence.killed: Compute noncommutative rank of the homogenized SAT pencil and declare SAT iff nc-rank is full.
algorithmic_consequence.also_killed: Any rounding claim that assumes every full-rank 2x2 blow-up of this clause-block space can be converted to a scalar Boolean completion without an additional theorem.
not_killed: a genuinely Boolean scalar algorithm over GF(2)
a lift that enforces Boolean tying/idempotence and proves no operator gap

next_target.name: E8_GLOBAL_BOOLEAN_SWITCH_ELIMINATION_V1_6
next_target.directive: Do not use unrestricted noncommutative blow-ups as the decision oracle. Attack the rank-3 Boolean switch while preserving scalar GF(2) semantics exactly.
